text:
Olivia (CSM): Hey team — FjordHealth is stalled on onboarding. Customer sent a vendor security questionnaire. Top asks: latest SOC2 report, signed DPA, a network/data flow diagram, and our retention policy. They said they need this before their legal can finish the purchase order. Any updates?

Josh (Security): We do have a SOC2 Type II attestation PDF from Oct 2024. I can share the secure link. It's redacted for 3rd-party vendor use. :white_check_mark:

Aneesha (Legal): @Olivia please send me the customer's standard DPA. I have our template with a couple of redlines ready; main negotiation points will be liability cap and sub-processing. If FjordHealth insists on their language, we'll need PO review. Trying to keep timeline to 48-72h.

Olivia (CSM): Sharing their DPA now in thread. They want data residency/processing details spelled out. Also asked about subprocessors list.

Mika (Eng): I can export an architecture diagram and a short data flow blurb (which systems see PII, where tokens are stored, retention TTL). Will put in the shared folder by EOD. Question: do we include quantized model caches as storage of derived data?

Josh (Security): For questionnaire, state: model KV cache does not persist customer prompt content beyond TTL, and we use encryption-at-rest + envelope keys via KMS. I'll draft the subprocessors list (cloud provider, monitoring, logging).

Aneesha (Legal): Once I have the vendor DPA + our template redline, I'll prepare a one-page summary of differences for the customer to speed sign-off. If they push for SOC2 scope detail, I'll ask security for the SOC scope statement.

Olivia (CSM): Great. Timeline ask from FjordHealth: prefer all docs within 72 hours to hit their onboarding window. Also flagged as a potential renewal risk if we stall (they have a pilot contract).

Mika (Eng): Uploaded diagram and short retention writeup to drive/fjord-onboarding folder: drive.redwood/internal/fjord-onboard/arch-2026-03-23.png and retention-clauses.md.

Josh (Security): Uploaded SOC2 link: secure.redwood/soc2/2024-typeII.pdf and SOC scope summary in that folder. Added subprocessors.csv.

Aneesha (Legal): Redline DPA uploaded to same folder and comments doc for commercial. I'll send a concise summary message to FjordHealth legal once you confirm SOC scope, @josh.

cs-bot: Onboarding checklist updated: fjordhealth -> docs uploaded, legal review pending. Next reminder in 24h.

Olivia (CSM): Thanks all — I'll coordinate with FjordHealth legal and push for signatures. I'll loop in sales if we hit any PO delays. :pray:
